independent_computation.step_1_identify_source: In roster 'cleaver_bloodsong_roster' the only resistance-reduction effect available is Black Cleaver's Carve. An exhaustive scan of every passive/active branch in data/items.json for armor/magic-resist reduction returns exactly four items: 3071 Black Cleaver (6%/stack, 5 stacks, 30% armor), 8010 Bloodletter's Curse (7.5%/stack, 4 stacks -> 30% MAGIC resist), 447112 Flesheater (flat 3 per stack, Arena-only: modes['classic sr 5v5'] == false), 3118 Malignance (no resistance reduction; scorched zone). Neither the 6% per-stack figure nor an armor reduction is produced by anything but Black Cleaver.
independent_computation.step_2_wiki_arithmetic: Per-stack fraction = 6% = 0.06. Cap = 5 stacks. Total at cap = 5 x 0.06 = 0.30, which matches the wiki's own stated total 'up to 30% at 5 stacks' exactly (self-consistent, so 30% is not a wiki typo).
independent_computation.step_3_semantics_of_the_leaf: The leaf is attached to a single combat event (events[35]) inside a list named `support_resistance_reduction`, whose element field is `fraction`. Per docs/math-foundations.md 2.2, resistance reduction enters as R <- R*(1 - r_pct/100), i.e. one applied magnitude per source at the moment of mitigation. A per-event record therefore carries the reduction in force at that event, not the per-stack rate (a per-stack rate is not usable at a mitigation site without a co-located stack count, and no stack multiplier appears in the reduction composition).
independent_computation.step_4_stack_state_at_event_35: Carve stacks on every physical-damage instance to the champion and lasts 6 s, reaching the 5-stack cap after 5 damage instances. Event index 35 is deep into a coupled roster timeline (>= 36 events), so the ally Cleaver holder is unambiguously at the 5-stack cap; math-foundations 2.3 also notes the 6 s stack duration exceeds any realistic inter-swing interval, so no expiry rescues a sub-cap value.
independent_computation.diagnosis_of_old_value: 0.06 is exactly the per-stack rate. The old baseline recorded the per-stack rate where the applied reduction belongs — a 5x understatement of the shred (armor multiplier 0.94 instead of 0.70), which understates all physical damage routed through the coupled event.

alternatives_considered.reasoning: docs/math-foundations.md 2.3 documents `ArmorReductionEffect.average_reduction` as 0.8 x max_stacks (= 4 stacks -> 24%), and the closed-form Cesàro mean C - C(C-1)/(2h) equals 4 stacks at h = 10 autos.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: That is a fight-aggregate averaging model — it collapses the stack ramp into one number for a whole hit sequence. This leaf is state attached to one event in the per-event ledger, where the ramp is resolved explicitly rather than averaged; at event 35 the ramp is saturated. An averaged constant appearing on a single event would also be internally inconsistent with the ledger's early events.

alternatives_considered.candidate: 0.06 as a per-stack rate with a sibling stack-count field
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Would make the old value correct under a different schema reading.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The field is named `fraction` on an entry in `support_resistance_reduction` — the reduction fraction, matching the r_pct/100 magnitude consumed by reduce_resistance. Nothing in the cached data or math-foundations describes a per-stack rate being carried to a mitigation site.

alternatives_considered.candidate: Bloodsong as the source (8%/5% Expose Weakness)
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Expose Weakness is a damage-taken amplifier, not a resistance reduction, and neither 0.06 nor 0.30 is derivable from 8%/5%.

notes: Evidence tree built with `git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>`; only data/ and docs/math-foundations.md were read. src/, tests/, scripts/, docs/plans/, docs/receipts/, the diff, and git history were not consulted.
The scenario/baseline JSON itself was never read — the value 0.30 is derived from the cached wiki text alone.
